name: Fund Parties 1
definition: Parties related to an investment fund.

Guarantor.name: Guarantor
Guarantor.definition: Guarantor of the financial instrument. When used in reference to MiFID, this is in the scope of the European MiFID Template (EMT) reference 00080.

Auditor.name: Auditor
Auditor.definition: Party that regularly monitors compliance with the legal regulations.

Trustee.name: Trustee
Trustee.definition: Legal owner of the financial instrument. However, the beneficiary has the equitable or beneficial ownership.
